projects.title: Hotel Tycoon: Idle Manager
projects.description: An idle tycoon game where players build, upgrade, and manage a growing hotel empire. Every tap and decision compounds — rooms, staff, amenities, and prestige unlock new revenue streams.

projects.title: Highway Havoc
projects.description: A vehicular action shooter — race down the highway, shoot down waves of enemies, and survive escalating chaos. Tight controls, punchy gunplay, and an arcade feel.

projects.title: Supreme Strike
projects.description: An action-striking game with timing-based combat. Land clean hits, build combos, and take down increasingly tough opponents across escalating stages.

projects.title: Goods Match
projects.description: A relaxing item-matching puzzle. Spot pairs across cluttered scenes, clear the board, and progress through cozy themed levels — easy to pick up, hard to put down.

projects.title: MR Smart Glass — QR Spawner
projects.description: A Unity Mixed Reality app for smart glasses. Scan a QR code and the prefab mapped to that code spawns into your space. Built for hands-free, on-the-go object lookup.

projects.title: VR AI Assistant
projects.description: A Unity VR experience with a voice-driven AI companion. Press Space → Whisper transcribes your speech → a local Ollama (phi3) model replies → Windows TTS speaks the response back in-world.

projects.title: AR Visualization
projects.description: A Unity AR app that lets users preview furniture in their real space before buying — point your camera at the floor, place a sofa, walk around it, see how it fits. Built in C# with Unity's AR Foundation.

projects.title: Car Racing Game
projects.description: A multiplayer car racing game in Unity using Photon Network — real-time multi-car sessions, networked physics, and competitive lap times. Players join a room and race head-to-head.

projects.title: Neo-Clothing
projects.description: A 3D WebGL configurator built in Unity for inspecting fabrics, tiles, and cloth materials. Spin the object, swap textures, recolor the cloth — runs straight in the browser, no install needed.

projects.title: E-Commerce Web API
projects.description: An e-commerce backend built with ASP.NET Core — REST endpoints for products, categories, carts, orders, and user accounts. JWT-secured auth, Entity Framework Core data layer, and a clean layered architecture that's easy to extend with new modules (payments, reviews, inventory).

projects.title: Prescription Generator Web API
projects.description: A healthcare backend that lets doctors compose, store, and export patient prescriptions. ASP.NET Core REST endpoints for patients, medicines, and prescriptions; printable PDF generation; role-based auth so doctors and patients only see what's theirs.
